name: beyond_mcp_review_submit
description: Submit a tool behavior review, ambiguity report, inefficiency, missing capability, or suggestion to the central MCP Review Board. The server computes the fingerprint and deduplicates repeated reports into occurrences. mcp_version describes the originating/reported runtime; metadata.review_server_mcp_version identifies the central review service separately. metadata.reporter is free-form text, not authenticated model identity; created_by_model may remain unknown when the client does not supply model identity.

summary.description: Short normalized description of the issue or suggestion.

evidence.description: Structured reproduction or result evidence. Do not include secrets.

context.description: Concise context that helps reproduce the MCP behavior.

output_contract_note: No outputSchema is declared by the inspected public source definition. Consult live help and actual results; do not infer a missing output contract.
